name: XMASS
full_name: Xenon detector for weakly interacting MASSive particles - neutrino programme
summary: XMASS was a single-phase liquid-xenon detector at Kamioka. Alongside dark-matter work, it searched for rare xenon decay channels and investigated low-energy solar-neutrino signatures.
detection_principle: Photomultipliers surrounding liquid xenon record scintillation light without extracting ionization charge. Light yield, event position and timing are used to select low-background electron-recoil and rare-decay samples.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: XMASS-I constrained the rare double-electron-capture process using a low-background liquid-xenon exposure.

science_scope: The archive records the neutrino and weak-decay research of a historical dark-matter detector. A double-electron-capture search is distinct from a neutrinoless double-beta-decay discovery.
